mapper.sql: c.id, c.title, c.author_user_id, c.cover_url, c.source_url, c.publish_time, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, u.source_user_id, u.location, s.like_count, s.comment_count, s.favorite_count, s.share_count, s.view_count
from content_items c join users u on u.id = c.author_user_id join content_stats s on s.content_id = c.id where c.status = 'published' and c.visibility = 'public' and c.type = 'video'

select t.content_id, t.word as term, s.like_count, s.favorite_count, s.share_count, s.view_count from content_recommend_words t join content_items c on c.id = t.content_id join content_stats s on s.content_id = c.id where c.status = 'published' and c.visibility = 'public' and c.type = 'video'

select t.content_id, t.tag as term, s.like_count, s.favorite_count, s.share_count, s.view_count from content_tags t join content_items c on c.id = t.content_id join content_stats s on s.content_id = c.id where c.status = 'published' and c.visibility = 'public' and c.type = 'video'
select tag from content_tags where content_id = #{contentId} order by sort_order
select word from content_recommend_words where content_id = #{contentId} order by sort_order
